_note: PixelLab provenance for the win/lose/leaderboard cards + powered Sally (Artwork Upgrade). Cards = themed 3/4 PixelLab scenes composited by scripts/compose_screens.py (dim + vignette + per-screen text scrims), with the shared standalone Sally (pixellab/_src/transitions/sally_dog.png) on the win + leaderboard cards. Outputs: pixellab/endscreens/{win,lose}.jpg (PNG bytes, .jpg name so assets.endscreen() finds them) and pixellab/ui/scoreboard.jpg. Map objects auto-expire after 8h, so the committed raw scenes here + composed cards are the durable artifact.

powered_sally._note: Distinct powered-up Sally spritesheet shown during the cake invincibility window (Player swaps to pixellab/characters_powered/ when is_invincible; falls back to normal Sally if absent). create_character (quadruped/dog template, low top-down, 4 dir) + animate_character template 'walk-4-frames'; frames fetched via curl into {down,up,right,left} (south->down,north->up,east->right,west->left).
powered_sally.look: white terrier with red superhero cape + golden glow aura
